description: Use this when the user wants a bounded ValuEdge stock screen for research candidates such as undervalued, quality, dividend, large-cap, or positive-free-cash-flow stocks. Choose a preset or compose supported filters for undervalued growth and other requests. Use the smallest faithful filter set and state chosen growth/valuation thresholds. Percentages are decimal fractions (0.15 = 15%). Presets only become stricter. The custom baseline requires market cap >=300 million in listing currency and valid canonical fair value. Public screening is NYSE/NASDAQ stocks with a 60-candidate window and at most 12 returned rows, not an exhaustive market scan; disclose incomplete results, source dates, missing coverage and negative-equity caveats. Arbitrary database queries and trade instructions are not supported.

filters.description: Optional conjunction (AND) of 1–24 public controls. Only tightens the selected preset; cannot remove its stock-only, exchange, market-cap, or fair-value baseline. Percentages are decimal fractions. Unsupported fields/operators are rejected.

currentRatioMin.description: Strictly greater than (>) current ratio. Plain ratio/multiple, not a percentage. Missing values do not qualify. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

debtEquityMax.description: At most (<=) debt equity. Plain ratio/multiple, not a percentage. Missing values do not qualify. Negative equity can produce a negative ratio; this condition alone does not establish low debt. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

dividendOnly.description: Require the existing dividend gate: dividend yield > 0.000001 (decimal fraction); omit to leave the selected preset unchanged.

dividendYieldMax.description: At most (<=) Dividend yield. Decimal fraction: 0.15 means 15%; 2 means 200%. Never send whole-percent units. Missing values do not qualify. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

dividendYieldMin.description: Strictly greater than (>) Dividend yield. Decimal fraction: 0.15 means 15%; 2 means 200%. Never send whole-percent units. Missing values do not qualify. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

epsGrowthYoyMin.description: Minimum; growth_comparison selects >= or > eps growth yoy. Decimal fraction: 0.15 means 15%; 2 means 200%. Never send whole-percent units. Missing values do not qualify. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

evEbitdaMax.description: Strictly less than (<) EV EBITDA. Plain ratio/multiple, not a percentage. Missing values do not qualify. Only positive multiples qualify. Catalog availability: partial_coverage; inspect response coverage and source dates.

sortBy.description: Server-side sort within the bounded candidate window. Does not establish an exhaustive universe ranking.

sortDir.description: Sort direction; defaults to descending when sortBy is supplied.

growth_comparison.description: For all growth minimums in a custom-filter call: gte means at least (default); gt means strictly greater. Other operators follow each field description: ratio/yield minimums are strict >, positive-multiple maximums are strict <, debt/equity and dividend-yield maximums are <=, and market-cap/score/MOS bounds are inclusive.

preset_id.description: Defaults to undervalued for preset-only calls, or custom when filters are supplied. Explicit presets retain their baseline conditions.
